title: Burlington, NC — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Burlington, NC: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Burlington is a city in NC with a population of 58,000. Piedmont city with the Burlington Outlet Village and a growing manufacturing sector. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees.
